title: DRI Conducts Search at Cipla's Vikhroli Office, Bhiwandi Depot Over Imported Drug
summary: Mumbai: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), Mumbai Zonal Unit, conducted search proceedings at the office of Cipla Limited in Vikhroli, Mumbai, and its depot in Bhiwandi, Thane,...

contentHtml:
Mumbai: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), Mumbai Zonal Unit, conducted search proceedings at the office of Cipla Limited in Vikhroli, Mumbai, and its depot in Bhiwandi, Thane, Maharashtra, in connection with the classification and exemption of an imported pharmaceutical finished product.

According to a regulatory disclosure, the search proceedings were initiated by the DRI on November 16,2026, under Section 105 of the Customs Act,1962.

The search was conducted at two company locations,including Cipla’s office in Vikhroli, Mumbai, and its depot situated in Bhiwandi, Thane. The company stated that it extended full cooperation and assistance to the authorities during the proceedings.

As detailed in the regulatory filing, the matter relates to the classification and exemption of an imported pharmaceutical finished product. The disclosure identifies the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Mumbai Zonal Unit, as the authority involved in the proceedings.

The search proceedings were initiated and concluded on the same day, November 16,2026. The company has clarified that the action has no material impact on its financials, operations or other activities.

Cipla Limited is a Mumbai-headquartered pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceutical products. The company operates across multiple therapeutic segments and has a presence in domestic and international pharmaceutical markets.

The regulatory disclosure does not specify the name of the imported pharmaceutical product or provide further details regarding the classification or exemption issue under examination.
